$comment: Build-time brand imagery for the public site. `npm run media` downloads every entry
into client/public/media at the stated size, so the paths seeded into CmsSections
resolve without a CDN and without checking binaries into the repo.
Sources are Unsplash (free, commercial use, no attribution required — credited anyway).
The uniform CSS grade in 03 §4 is applied at render time by the .graded utility, so the
downloaded originals stay untouched and can be re-graded by changing one CSS rule.
Entries with "pending": true are seeded in the CMS but not yet sourced. They belong to
the imagery pass in Phase 1 (public website), which needs the full trainer, class,
transformation, testimonial, blog and product sets.

deliverable or belongs to a later module.
pending.hero/forge-hero.mp4: STILL PENDING. 6–10s muted loop, Pexels Videos (search: weightlifting slow motion), trimmed to 2–4 MB. Needs ffmpeg to trim, strip audio and produce the WebM sibling — not installed here, and an untrimmed 4K clip with audio would breach 03 §4. The hero renders its poster meanwhile, which is the designed fallback, not a placeholder.
pending.hero/forge-hero.webm: WebM sibling of the same loop.
pending.transformations/*.jpg: REPLACE BEFORE LAUNCH. Currently stock stand-ins so the gallery renders. These must be the client's own consented member photographs — the section publishes named people with weights and timelines.
pending.trainers/*.jpg: REPLACE BEFORE LAUNCH. Stock coaches, chosen dark and on-palette with no competitor branding, but they are not the client's actual staff.
pending.app/forge-app-home.png: Optional. Absent by design: the QR section draws the member-app home screen from live tokens instead, which stays sharp and cannot drift out of date with the palette. Drop a real capture here and it takes over automatically.
pending.brand/forge-wordmark.svg: Optional. Client-supplied once the brand name is final. Nothing references it yet — the header and footer set the wordmark in Clash Display.
pending.exercises/*.jpg: Module 3 (member portal) — thumbnails for the 35-exercise library.
pending.shop/*.jpg: Module 2 (POS) — product shots for the retail catalogue.
